roleEssence: Moran is an HR Business Partner supporting a portfolio of managers across the Executive team and Finance & Operations, coaching them through people decisions - hiring, performance, team structure - on an ongoing basis. The work is relationship-driven and advisory rather than project-based: she's a trusted resource these leaders return to repeatedly, not someone executing a single deliverable. Expertise here looks like sound judgment on people situations plus enough context across very different functions (Executive strategy, Finance operations) to advise leaders credibly in both.

onboardingNeeds.title: Meet the managers you support
onboardingNeeds.purpose: Get to know the leaders you'll be supporting, so they have a name and face before their first real ask.
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence is fundamentally about an ongoing portfolio of leadership relationships, not a task or deliverable - meeting them is the single most direct onboarding need this role implies. Portfolio size (9) comes from peopleSupported, not invented.

onboardingNeeds.title: Shadow a senior HRBP in a real advisory conversation
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence defines this role as an ongoing advisory relationship, not a task - the meetings with the managers she supports ARE the core work, so seeing what a real advisory conversation looks like before she's running her own directly supports and precedes those relationship meetings, scheduled separately. Not a standalone skill unrelated to them - the two connect.
